A little something for Sofie

Gift Ideas

Your presence and prayers are already a beautiful gift. If you wish to bring something for Sofie, here are a few thoughtful ideas.

🧸
Baby essentialsSoft clothes, swaddles, baby towels, bibs, or age-appropriate essentials.
📚
Keepsakes & storybooksA children’s Bible, bedtime storybook, memory book, or a personalized keepsake box.
🕊️
Meaningful baptism keepsakesA small cross, angel keepsake, engraved name frame, or a keepsake ornament.
💌
Cards and blessingsA handwritten prayer, blessing, or loving message for Sofie to read when she is older.
🎁
Gift of your choiceGifts are completely optional. Please choose whatever feels comfortable for you.

Kindly avoid small parts or toys that are not suitable for babies. Thank you for keeping Sofie’s safety in mind.

For everyone’s comfort

Health & Safety Notes

We want this special day to feel comfortable and safe for Sofie and all our loved ones.

🤍
Please stay home if unwellIf you have a fever, cough, flu-like symptoms, or feel unwell, please rest and recover at home.
🧼
Clean hands, happy hugsPlease sanitize or wash your hands before greeting or touching the baby.
💋
Gentle greetings for babyTo help protect our little one, please avoid kissing Sofie’s face and hands.
😷
Consider a mask when neededGuests who are recovering from a respiratory illness or prefer extra protection are welcome to wear a mask.

These are family requests to help everyone feel comfortable; please also follow any current guidance from the church or venue.

A gentle guide for the day

Celebration Details

👗
Suggested attirePastel pink, ivory, white, beige, or other soft colors. Dress comfortably and respectfully for the church ceremony.
⏰
Arrival timePlease aim to arrive 15–20 minutes before the 10:00 AM ceremony so everyone can settle in.
📍
Venue remindersUse the map links above to check directions before leaving. Please verify the exact church entrance and reception details with the family.
💗
Most important of allBring your smiles, your prayers, and your love for Sofie. We’re grateful to share this milestone with you.
